description.zh:
AI任务管道ID。

> 有默认ID，可不填写。如果需要批量导入，需要使用单独的任务管道，请提交工单申请配置或联系阿里云售后进行配置，关于如何提交工单，请参见[联系我们](~~464625~~)。
description.en:
The AI pipeline ID.

> If you leave this parameter empty, the system uses a default pipeline ID. If you need to perform batch imports, you must use a dedicated pipeline. To request a dedicated pipeline, submit a ticket or contact Alibaba Cloud after-sales support. For more information about how to submit a ticket, see [Contact Us](~~464625~~).

description.zh:
AI图片模板ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过[AddAITemplate](~~102930~~)接口创建图片模板时，返回参数TemplateId的值。
- 模板创建后，可通过[ListAITemplate](~~102936~~)接口查询AI图片模板ID，为请求后返回参数TemplateId的值。
description.en:
The AI image template ID. You can obtain the template ID in the following ways:

- If you create an image template by calling the [AddAITemplate](~~102930~~) operation, the template ID is the `TemplateId` in the response.

- After you create a template, you can call the [ListAITemplate](~~102936~~) operation to query the AI image template ID. The template ID is the `TemplateId` in the response.

description.zh:
自定义设置。
- 必须是JSON字符串。
- 需要包含MessageCallback或者Extend参数。
- 最大长度为512个字节。

参数构造详情，请参见[UserData](~~86952~~)。
description.en:
Custom settings.

- The value must be a JSON string.

- The value must include the `MessageCallback` or `Extend` parameter.

- The maximum length is 512 bytes.

For more information about how to structure this parameter, see [UserData](~~86952~~).

description.zh:
视频ID。可通过以下方式获取：
- 通过控制台上传的视频，可登录[点播控制台](https://vod.console.aliyun.com)，选择**媒资库** > **音/视频**查看视频ID。
- 通过[CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~)接口上传视频时，视频ID为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 视频上传后，可通过[SearchMedia](~~86044~~)接口查询视频ID，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The video ID. You can obtain the video ID in the following ways:

- To find the ID of a video uploaded from the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and navigate to **Media Assets** > **Audio/Video**.

- If you upload a video by calling the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation, the video ID is the `VideoId` in the response.

- After you upload a video, call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the video ID. The video ID is the `VideoId` in the response.

descriptions.zh:
- 目前本接口支持的服务地域：**华北2（北京）**、**华东2（上海）**。
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027551~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[GetAIImageJobs](~~186923~~)主动查询任务执行结果。
descriptions.en:
- This operation is available in the following service regions: **China (Beijing)** and **China (Shanghai)**.

- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027551~~). After you submit a job, the operation returns a job ID. The job is queued for asynchronous processing. The system delivers the result through a [callback notification](~~186923~~). You can also call the GetAIImageJobs operation to query the job status.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vod submit-ai-image-job --video-id 357a8748c57740000089d2726e6436aa --ai-template-id ef1a8842cb9f00000cea80cad902e416 --user-data Extend_:_localId_:_0000_,_test_:_www --ai-pipeline-id 6492025b8f000006ba5bb755a33438 --region cn-hangzhou
